owner_calls.question: In X2, Stryker takes control of Kurt's mind and sends him to attack the President in the White House. Should this mind-controlled mission count as forced service in Stryker's group (a stage before 'The X-Men' at X2)? If so, under what name? The screen never names Stryker's X2 operation, and the brief says it is not 'Weapon X'.
options: Keep as is (he is Stryker's captive and victim, the same way T:fox-lady-deathstrike has no group)
Add a forced-service stage at X2 before ['The X-Men','X2'] (the owner chooses the name, e.g. 'U.S. Army' as on T:fox-stryker's X2 stage)
owner_calls.evidence: X2: 'Nightcrawler was controlled by Colonel William Stryker to assassinate the President'. Stryker's soldiers had captured him and held him at Alkali Lake. Afterwards he joins the X-Men's rescue mission. The wiki lists Stryker as his 'Former Captor', and his affiliation is only the X-Men.
